provenance: Original pictograms drawn in pipeline/lobby.py (SVG on a 64 grid); nothing traced, sampled or recoloured from Melee or any other game.

textures.name: ico_strike_x
textures.why: white mask tinted by material colour; 16 edge levels are plenty
textures.use: stage tile struck by P1: a cross (P1's strike shape)

textures.name: ico_strike_o
textures.why: white mask tinted by material colour; 16 edge levels are plenty
textures.use: stage tile struck by P2: a barred ring (P2's strike shape - never the same shape as P1's)
